app.title: Mindustry Launcher
main.title: 🎮 Mindustry Launcher
main.profile_frame: Save profile (each profile keeps its own game data)
settings.title: ⚙️ Launcher settings
settings.intro:
"Save profile settings" apply only to the current profile; "Launcher settings" apply to all profiles.
To switch profiles, use the dropdown at the top of the main window.
settings.hint.data_dir: This only changes which folder is used from now on; existing saves are not moved for you.
settings.hint.min_playtime: ← sessions shorter than this are not backed up
settings.hint.max_backups: ← the oldest is deleted beyond this
settings.hint.launcher_update: Only the launcher's own files are replaced - game versions, config, backups and saves are untouched; disabled when running from source
settings.hint.language: ← changes as soon as you click "Save and go back"
settings.hint.jre_path: Either the JRE or the JDK root works (it must contain bin\java.exe); "jre" means the folder next to the launcher
settings.hint.mirror: Prefixed to download URLs for acceleration; empty = direct GitHub. If one mirror fails, the next is tried
settings.hint.mirror_test: Click Speed test to measure each candidate, then pick the fastest (the result goes into the box above)
settings.hint.extra_vm: Placed before -cp, e.g. -Xmx4G; space-separated - wrap an item in double quotes if it contains spaces
settings.hint.extra_prog: Passed to the game after the main class (rarely needed; mainly for troubleshooting)
settings.hint.max_logs: ← the oldest are dropped beyond this (takes effect on the next launch)
settings.hint.permanent_delete: ← only affects user files such as save folders and old logs
settings.hide_on_launch: Hide the window while the game runs
settings.close_on_exit: Close the launcher when the game exits (after backups finish)
settings.save_game_log: Save game output to logs/ (if off, it is shown live in the log window only)
settings.permanent_delete: Delete files permanently (bypass the recycle bin, cannot be undone)
settings.game_running: Settings cannot be opened while the game is running
jre.idle: Click "Test" to run java -version and confirm it works
mirror_test.title: GitHub mirror speed test
mirror_test.intro: Downloads a small sample (about {size}) through each candidate and sorts by speed. Select a row, then click Use selected.
mirror_test.need_select: Select a row in the list first
mirror_test.none_ok: No candidate passed: try again on another network, or later
mirror_test.applied: ✅ {name} filled in - click Save and go back to apply
reset.title: Confirm reset
reset.body:
Reset the backup policy, global switches and Java path of "{name}" to defaults?
(The data folder, the profile list and existing backups are left alone.)
reset.done: Defaults restored - click "Save and go back" to apply
err.args_body:
{err}

Arguments are separated by spaces; if an item itself contains spaces, wrap it in double quotes, e.g. -Dfoo="a b".
err.mirror_body:
"{text}" does not look like a valid mirror address.

Write the full acceleration prefix, e.g. https://ghfast.top/
Leave it empty to connect to GitHub directly (no acceleration).
err.jre_empty:
The Java path cannot be empty.

"jre" means the jre folder next to the launcher; an absolute JRE/JDK path also works.
err.logs_title: Problem with log files to keep
err.logs_body: Enter a whole number between 1 and {max}.
err.save_dir: Failed to update the save folder: {err}
warn.args_title: Launch arguments may be a problem
dialog.copy.same_dir: Source and destination are the same directory
dialog.copy.src_in_dst: Source is inside the destination — copying would recurse forever
dialog.copy.dst_in_src: Destination is inside the source — copying would recurse forever
backup.title: Manage backups - profile “{profile}”
backup.isolated_note: (Backups are isolated per profile; only the current one is shown here)
backup.running_body: Backing up while the game is running may corrupt the save. Continue?
backup.restore_running: Cannot restore backups while the game is running
backup.note_prompt: Enter a note (leave empty to show the timestamp):
versions.running: Cannot manage versions while the game is running
versions.title: Manage versions
config.profile.forbidden: Profile name cannot contain these characters: {chars}
config.profile.trailing_dot: Profile name cannot end with a period
config.profile.reserved: “{name}” is a reserved system name, please choose another
config.profile.too_long: Profile name must not exceed 40 characters
config.profile.need_one: At least one save profile must be kept
config.version.forbidden: Version number cannot contain these characters: {chars}
config.version.control_char: Version number cannot contain control characters
config.version.too_long: Version number must not exceed 40 characters
config.recycle.windows_only: Moving to the Recycle Bin is only supported on Windows
config.recycle.failed: Failed to move to the Recycle Bin (error code {code})
storage.zip_slip: Snapshot entry path escapes the target; extraction refused: {name}
storage.restore_rollback_failed:
Restore failed and rollback also failed.

The full snapshot from before the restore has been kept at:
{snapshot}

You can extract it back into the data directory manually.
storage.snapshot_invalid: The generated snapshot is not a valid zip (possibly out of disk space)
storage.snapshot_failed:
Could not create a safety snapshot for the current save; restore cancelled (the save directory was not modified).

{err}
updater.found_auto: 📥 New version found; starting automatic download...
selfupdate.wait_timeout: Timed out waiting for the old process to exit; no changes were made
selfupdate.staged_missing: Not found in the staging area: {rel}
selfupdate.download_failed: Failed to download the update package
log.where.none: (not saved to disk, this session only)
log.state.dropped: ; only the last {max} lines kept in memory, {dropped} lines dropped
game.no_versions: No game version found, please import one
game.download_pending: ⏬ A download is in progress, not closing the launcher yet
profiles.title: Manage save profiles
profiles.busy_switch: Can't switch save profiles while the game is running
profiles.busy_manage: Can't manage save profiles while the game is running
profiles.intro: Each profile has its own game data directory, backups and backup policy; just switch before launching. ★ marks the profile currently in use.
profiles.need_select: Please select a save profile first
profiles.pick_data_dir: Choose the game data directory for “{name}” (cancel to use the default)
profiles.copy_pick_prompt:
Copy which profile's data to “{name}”?
Everything in that profile's data directory (saves / mods / schematics / settings, etc.) will be copied; files with the same name will be overwritten.
Click “Skip” to copy nothing.
profiles.created: ✅ Created and switched to save profile “{name}”
profiles.change_path_pick: Choose a new game data directory for “{name}”
profiles.dir_missing_open:
{path}

This directory does not exist yet. Create and open it?
profiles.delete_no_select_body: Please click the save profile you want to delete in the list first.
profiles.delete_last_body:
“{name}” is the only save profile left; deleting it would leave the launcher unusable.

If you only want to clear its game data, check just “Game data directory” in the dialog below.
profiles.delete_running_body: Please close the game before deleting a save profile.
profiles.dst_permanent: permanently delete (bypassing the Recycle Bin, unrecoverable)
profiles.confirm_recycle: move to the Windows Recycle Bin
profiles.delete_hint: Check the items to process as well. Checking everything = removing this profile completely.
profiles.delete_note_permanent:
Note: the data directory will be permanently deleted, bypassing the Recycle Bin and unrecoverable (the “Permanently delete files” option is on in Settings).
Backup records moved to the _trash directory will not be cleaned up automatically.
profiles.item_cfg_detail: Remove “{name}” from config.json so it no longer appears in the launcher's profile list.
profiles.item_data_native_warn: ⚠️ This is the game's native data directory; deleting it wipes your main saves!
profiles.item_data_missing_detail:
{data_dir}
      This directory does not exist; nothing to do.
profiles.nothing_checked_body: No items were checked, so nothing was done.
profiles.orphan_body:
You checked “Profile config” but not “Game data directory”.

After deleting the profile, this directory will be left behind on disk:
{data_dir}

Continue anyway?
profiles.danger_body:
“{name}”'s data directory is Mindustry's native directory:
{data_dir}

Deleting it (even to the Recycle Bin) means the game can no longer find your saves.

Delete it as well?
updates.game_running: The game is running. Close it before checking for updates
updates.downloading: A download is already in progress
updates.check_failed: ❌ Update check failed. Please check your network
updates.all_latest: ✅ All versions are up to date
updates.checking_bg: 🔍 Checking for updates in the background...
updates.self_staged: ✅ Launcher update v{version} is ready; it will be applied automatically when you close the launcher
updates.self_available: ℹ️ A new launcher version v{version} is available (you can enable auto-update in settings)
updates.self_failed: ⚠️ Failed to download the launcher update: {reason}
updates.self_previous_failed: ⚠️ The previous launcher update (v{version}) did not take effect
updates.self_previous_incomplete: ⚠️ The previous launcher update did not complete (see launcher.log for details)
core.jre_fallback_default: No java.exe found under the jre path “{path}”; reverted to the default jre/
core.jre_use_system: jre folder not found; using the system Java for now: {path}
core.jre_missing:
The jre folder was not found. It needs to sit in the same folder as the launcher:

    {exe}

Make sure the jre folder has not been deleted or moved.
(Also looked for a usable Java in JAVA_HOME and PATH, but found none: {why})
(If you changed the Java path in settings or config.json, check that path too; it is currently “{path}”)
args.conflict_cp: “{arg}” overrides the launcher's assembled runtime jar (-cp below is overwritten entirely)
args.conflict_classpath: “{arg}” overrides the launcher's assembled runtime jar
args.conflict_jar: “{arg}” overrides the main class and the game will not start
args.conflict_data_dir: “{arg}” overrides the launcher's save isolation — switching save profiles will still read and write the same folder; make sure this is intended
args.err_nul: Arguments cannot contain a NUL character
args.java_timeout: Did not finish within {sec} seconds (possibly stuck in an antivirus scan)
args.java_unknown_output: Unrecognized output (does not look like java -version): {head}
args.java_not_in_env: No java.exe found in JAVA_HOME or PATH
args.java_env_all_dead: Every java found via environment variables failed to start (it may have been uninstalled)
